title: Putin Is Open to Meeting With North Korea’s Leader in China, Kremlin Says
summary_full: President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia could meet with Kim Jong-un if he travels to Shenzhen for the APEC summit this week. North Korea has not confirmed whether Mr. Kim will attend.
